units.source_text: 我對這唯一寄託的優秀品質都產生了疑惑，一切變得越來越莫名其妙的難懂，自己能前往面對的只有酒。

en.t: I even began to doubt the one excellent quality I had depended on, and as everything grew more and more incomprehensible, the only thing I could turn toward was alcohol.

units.source_text: 我的面部表情變得極度卑賤，早晨睜開眼就喝燒酒，牙齒脫落了好幾顆，所畫的漫畫幾乎是清一色下流的春宮圖。

en.t: My facial expression became utterly base; I drank shochu as soon as I opened my eyes in the morning, several of my teeth fell out, and the comics I drew were almost entirely vulgar erotic pictures.

units.source_text: 不，坦白說，從那時起，我開始暗中兜售自己臨摹的春宮圖了，因為我需要燒酒錢。

en.t: No, to be honest, from that time on I began secretly peddling erotic pictures I had copied myself, because I needed money for shochu.

units.source_text: 看著總是畏畏縮縮不敢正視我的良子，我心裡想，

en.t: Watching Yoshiko, who was always trembling and afraid to look me straight in the face, I thought to myself,

units.source_text: 她是一個完全沒有戒心的人，或許不止一次跟那個商人發生過關係吧，

en.t: She was a person with absolutely no wariness, so perhaps she had been involved with that merchant more than once,

units.source_text: 不，說不定跟某個我不知道的人也有過吧。

en.t: No, perhaps there had even been someone I knew nothing about.
